unplayedCards.name: BUDDY
unplayedCards.effect: Normal form: cards played in BUDDY's district cost 1 less Motion (minimum 0). After two rounds, BUDDY gains +3 Hands and planted Buddy Buds sprout. On reveal, plant Buds in two or three randomly chosen eligible districts; when each Bud sprouts, it gives +3 Hands to the last eligible friendly character already in its district. Full districts are skipped; Buds that sprout with no eligible friendly recipient remain harmless and give no Hands. Buds planted too late to sprout before match end are not placed.

unplayedCards.name: Dr. Fade
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy here -2 Hands. Give your weakest ally in another district +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Boss Bae
unplayedCards.effect: The first 2 times you play a card in another district, gain +1 Hands. After the second, your next card costing 4 or more costs 1 less Motion.

unplayedCards.name: Scammer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Copy the base Hands (up to 7) and printed ability of the strongest active Ongoing enemy here. If none exists, copy only the strongest enemy's base Hands (up to 7) and gain +1 Hand. Copied entrances never trigger.

unplayedCards.name: Closet Nerd
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Silence the highest-Hands active Ongoing enemy here, otherwise the strongest enemy, bypassing Wifey's Side Eye. Protection still blocks this. Newly interrupting an active Ongoing ability grants +1 Hand and reveals one enemy hand card.

unplayedCards.name: Plug
unplayedCards.effect: Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

unplayedCards.name: Live Streamer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Reset your cheap-play trigger counter. The next 2 cards you play this turn with cost 2 or less gain +1 Hand each.

unplayedCards.name: Gamer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands ally in each other district +2 Hands. Ongoing: While on board, the first time each round you newly Silence or Weaken an enemy, your lowest-Hands Dark ally gains +2 Hands. Ongoing: While Gamer is in your hand, your other Dark characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Techbro Rich
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Borrow up to 1 Motion, up to the cap. At round end repay unspent borrowed Motion; any remainder reduces your next round starting Motion. Once per match.

unplayedCards.name: Bikelife YN
unplayedCards.effect: After reveal, ride to your weakest other district and gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Cool Vibe YN
unplayedCards.effect: Pull your lowest ally from another district here. Both gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Barber Bro
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus Hands. Give the amount actually trimmed to your weakest other ally here. If no enemy has bonus Hands, give that ally +1 Hand. Ongoing: While Barber Bro is in your hand, your other Normal characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Bottle Girl
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If played on Round 4 or later, gain +2 Hands. Your next Poison character costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1, through the next round.

unplayedCards.name: Sneaker Reseller
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +X Hands where X is the printed Power of the highest-Hands enemy on the board, up to +3. Apply Weaken to that enemy.

unplayedCards.name: Church Auntie
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other ally here +3 Hands if Light, or +2 otherwise, and Protect. Ongoing: While on board, the first time each round protection blocks a hostile effect on one of your Light characters, it gains +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Landlord
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first enemy card played at this district each round costs 1 additional Motion. When that tax is actually paid, Landlord gains +1 Hands once per round.

unplayedCards.name: Car Meet Kid
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move Car Meet Kid to your weakest other district. Then give its lowest-Hands other friendly card +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Promoter
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Reveal one enemy hand card. If it costs 4+, your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion. Ongoing: While on board, the first Air ally, Bottle Girl, Pirate Radio DJ, or Dance Captain to move each round gains +2 Hands (one shared trigger).

unplayedCards.name: Nail Tech
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give another friendly card here +2 Hands. The next time that card is hit by an enemy Hands reduction, reduce that loss by 1. Ongoing: While Nail Tech is in your hand, your other Poison characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Delivery Demon
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move the lowest-Hands other friendly 1- or 2-Cost card here to your weakest other district.

unplayedCards.name: Racially Ambiguous Transplant
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have no other cards here, gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Bad Lil Cousin Tayaty
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand, then repeat the last resolved On Reveal if it is repeatable, using Tayaty as its source. If it cannot be repeated, gain Protection instead. Persistent creative contracts cannot be re-armed.

unplayedCards.name: Edgar
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly character here costs 2 or less, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Nguyen
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have a friendly card in another district, gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Man-Man
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have at least 2 other friendly characters here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Pinay Nurse
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other ally here +3 Hands and cleanse its freeze and silence.

unplayedCards.name: Honest Thot
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Name your weakest other district. Through next round, your next Air character entering there gains +2 Hands. One welcome per side.

unplayedCards.name: Earthy Sugar Foot
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other card here +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Abuela
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest injured ally anywhere +1 Hand, restore up to 3 Hands actually lost to damage, and Protect it. If nobody is injured, give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand, Protect it, and pack one lunch: heal up to 2 Hands of its first later enemy damage if it survives. Ongoing: While Abuela is in your hand, your other Light characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Ice Cream Truck
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Serve a +2-Hand Treat to your weakest other ally here, or leave it for the next friendly character arriving here. Ongoing: At round start, move to your weakest legal unvisited district and serve its weakest other ally, or leave a Treat if alone. Any successful first visit serves that district. One pending Treat per district per side; each district once per truck. Movement locks apply.

unplayedCards.name: Shiesty YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: 50% chance to summon another Shiesty YN here. Each summoned copy repeats this effect, up to 8 extra.

unplayedCards.name: Torta
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Pair yourself with your weakest other Earth ally here and Protect that partner. At next round end (or final round end), if both remain here and you are not losing this district, each gains +3 Hands. One pair per side. Ongoing: While Torta is in your hand, your other Earth characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Balikbayan Box Bot
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Leave a care package in each other district through next round. The next ally played or moved there gains +1 Hand (+2 if Earth) and is cleansed. One package per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: Bodega Cat
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have no other friendly cards here, gain +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Crossing Guard
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest unprotected other ally here. Give it one Safe Crossing: its next successful move ignores movement Lock. Capacity and district restrictions still apply.

unplayedCards.name: Laundromat Regular
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it +1 Hand. Its next successful move cleanses it again and gives it +1 Hand, once.

unplayedCards.name: Corner Busker
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first distinct other ally moving here gives your weakest other local ally +1 Hand; the second gives +2. At most one two-visitor payout per round. A visitor cannot tip twice toward a payout.

unplayedCards.name: Night Cashier
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: On round 4 or later, issue a Receipt here through next round. Your next other character costing 2 or less played here earns an immediate one-use local 1-Motion character discount, minimum 1. In the final round, that customer gains +2 Hands instead.

unplayedCards.name: Dog Walker
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If at least 2 other friendly characters are here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Mural Apprentice
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Paint this district with your element through next round. The next other friendly character of a different element entering here gains +2 Hands. One paint per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: Chess Regular
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy in up to two different districts through next round. With one mark, wait for an enemy placement in another district to complete the Fork. The next enemy placement after completion saves that district; other marked enemies lose 2 Hands. If a marked enemy loses Hands, Chess Regular gains +1 Hand. One Fork per side.

unplayedCards.name: Rooftop Gardener
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Plant a Seed here. At the end of this round, your weakest Plant ally here gains +4 Hands. One plot per district per side. Ongoing: While Rooftop Gardener is in your hand, your other Plant characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Pirate Radio DJ
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands ally in each other district +1 Hand. Ongoing: In hand, your other Electric characters gain +1 Hand at round end. On board, your second Electric character played each round gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Dance Circle Captain
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, the first friendly character move sets a destination. The next different friendly character moving there gains +2 Hands and Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Night Shift Medic
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse Freeze, Silence, Burn, Weaken, and Lock from every other ally here. Give your weakest other Light character here +1 Hand, even if healthy. Ongoing: While on board, the first Light character you cleanse each round gains +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Subway Magician
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here, then move to your weakest other district.

unplayedCards.name: OG Dominican
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If moved, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Last Train Conductor
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your lowest-Hands other ally here to your weakest other district. If moved, Cleanse it and give it +2 Hands, or +3 if it is Water.

unplayedCards.name: Midnight Mayor
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Nominate your weakest other district through next round. The next friendly move there grants that mover Protection and opens one local 1-Motion character discount, minimum 1. One nomination per side.

unplayedCards.name: Big Zoey
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other ally here +2 Hands and the lowest-Hands enemy here -2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Leroy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 4 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus, then hit that enemy for 2; with no bonus target, hit the strongest enemy here for 2. If your board has at least three friendly elements, gain +3 Hands and Protection. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity block the hostile package.

unplayedCards.name: Block Party Titan
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Bring the weakest movable ally from each other district here, if there is space. Gain +1 Hand for each ally that arrives, up to +2.

unplayedCards.name: Energy Drink
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Restore 3 Motion, up to the 9-Motion cap.

unplayedCards.name: Phone Charger
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Restore 1 Motion per friendly character here, up to 3. With at least 3 characters here, also Protect your weakest local Electric character.

unplayedCards.name: First Aid Kit
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest afflicted character here, or your weakest character if none is afflicted. Store one emergency kit: prevent up to 2 Hands of its next enemy damage before lethal resolution. One kit per target.

unplayedCards.name: Boombox
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give every friendly character here +1 Hand. Leave one Encore through next round: the next friendly movement arrival here gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Subway Map
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your lowest-Hands friendly character here to your weakest other district. If moved, give it +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Buttahs
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands friendly character here +2 Hands and protect it from one targeted hostile ability.

unplayedCards.name: Homeless YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If enemies outnumber your other friendly cards here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Sports Prodigy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If losing this district, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hand. Otherwise, arm one comeback through next round (once per match): when an enemy arrival turns this district from tied or winning to losing, gain +2 Hands and give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Fein
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If an enemy is here, gain +1 Hand. If 2 or more enemies are here, also apply 1 Burn to the highest-Hands enemy.

unplayedCards.name: STUD
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand and bond to it. Once while together, intercept its next targeted hostile ability, then try to move the surviving pair to your weakest other district with two spaces. Protect the surviving partner whether the escape succeeds or is blocked.

unplayedCards.name: Goth Kid
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to the first completely empty district. The first enemy played or moved there while you remain active is Silenced before its ability. If no empty district is available, Silence the lowest-Hands enemy here with a printed cost of 3 or less.

unplayedCards.name: Stoner Jr.
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your lowest-Hands frozen or silenced friendly character here. If cleansed, give it +1 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Stoner Sr.
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest afflicted ally here and leave a token through next round. Your next other character arriving here gains +4 Hands. If you cleansed an ally, pass a smaller +1 token once to a different arrival.

unplayedCards.name: Divorced Dad
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable ally costing 2 or less from another district here if there is room; Protect it. Through next round, its first successful move back to its original district gains +1 Hand. It never returns automatically. One visit per side.

unplayedCards.name: BBL Nice
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Pair your two weakest other allies anywhere through next round. Once per round, the first positive Hands gain on one shares up to 2 Hands with the other. Shared gains cannot repeat.

unplayedCards.name: Break
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other ally here to your weakest other open district. If it moves, leave a floor mark here through next round: Weaken the next enemy character entering. One mark per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: Bboy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move through your weakest other occupied friendly district, then to the remaining district if open. Gain +1 Hand per successful move, up to +2.

unplayedCards.name: Yung Hustle
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If a friendly character is in another district, restore 1 Motion, up to 9.

unplayedCards.name: Failed Rapper
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Leave a Verse here through next round. The next different friendly character entering by play or movement gains +2 Hands. Played characters collect after their entrance. One Verse per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: Failed Athlete
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per match, gain +4 Hands and Protection when this district changes from tied or winning to losing. If deployed while losing, a later enemy arrival here while still losing can also trigger the comeback.

unplayedCards.name: Incel
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: At round end, if you are the only friendly character here, gain +2 Hands, at most twice per match.

unplayedCards.name: Red Pill
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply Weaken to the highest-Hands enemy here. If already Weakened, Silence them and gain +2 Hands instead.

unplayedCards.name: Simmy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give the highest-Hands enemy here -3 Hands and your lowest-Hands other friendly character here +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Foodz
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse every other friendly character on your board. Give your weakest other character in each district +2 Hands. Give an extra +2 to the weakest Light ally actually cleansed. Community Serving: once per side per match, also give your weakest Homeless ally in each district +2 Hands and Protection, including Cracked Head. The serving is spent only when a Homeless ally is present; copies and repeated reveals share it.

unplayedCards.name: Dragonfly Jones
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Target the enemy here with the most removable bonus Hands, otherwise the highest-cost enemy costing 4 or more, otherwise the strongest enemy. Hit it for 4 if it has bonus Hands or costs 4 or more; otherwise hit it for 2. Gain +1 Hand only if damage lands.

unplayedCards.name: Sho'Nuff
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 5 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus Hands and gain the amount actually taken. If no enemy has bonus Hands, hit the strongest enemy here for 3. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity apply.

unplayedCards.name: Yasuke
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest unprotected other ally here +2 Hands and Protection, then hit the strongest enemy here for 2. Protection and immunity apply to the hit.

unplayedCards.name: Mansa Musa
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other friendly character in each district +1 Hand, or +2 if that ally is Earth. Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

unplayedCards.name: TRON
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give up to three lowest-Hands other friendly characters here +1 Hands each. If all three gained Hands, restore 1 Motion.

unplayedCards.name: John Henry
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand for each other friendly Earth character across the board, up to +4. If at least two are here, give the strongest enemy here -2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Ashlee
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Drop Guyana the gorilla (+4, uncounterable) into your weakest friendly district. Give every other friendly character in Ashlee's district +1 Hand. Give the highest-Hands enemy on the board -1 Hand. If Plant allies occupy at least two districts, give your lowest-Hands Plant ally in each occupied district +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Captain Jigga
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Send two 2-Hand Stewards here. Each targets a different highest-Hands enemy for -2 Hands and gives your lowest-Hands other Air character here +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Shotta
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 2. Ongoing: After you play another character in a different district, fire 1 at its strongest enemy. Two encores per match, at most one per round.

unplayedCards.name: Homeless Guy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Choose 0–4 extra Motion; gain that many Hands, plus 1 if you invested any Motion. If the deployment cost alone spent your last Motion, instead steal up to 2 Hands from the strongest enemy here.

unplayedCards.name: Fangirl
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Your strongest other ally here becomes your idol. Ongoing: The first time your idol gains Hands each round, gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Grown-Man Fanboy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Your strongest other ally becomes your idol. Ongoing: Intercept the first hostile ability targeting your idol each round. If Fangirl is here when you take the hit, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Lawless YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move the weakest enemy here to their strongest other open district. If it moves, Lawless YN gains +1 Hand. Protection, immunity and movement locks can stop this.

unplayedCards.name: The Street Apostle
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first time another Plant ally gains Hands each round, repeat up to 2 of that gain onto your weakest Plant ally in each other district. Copied gains cannot trigger this again.

unplayedCards.name: The Asphalt Apostle
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest other Earth ally anywhere and give it +1 Hand. Ongoing: Once per round, block the first hostile forced move against an Earth ally; give that ally +2 Hands instead.

unplayedCards.name: Cologne Criminal
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Leave Lingering Scent here through the end of next round. The first enemy entering this district each round gets 2 Burn, even if moved here. Scent stays after you leave.

unplayedCards.name: Passport Bro
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest movable other ally here to your weakest other legal open district. If it moves, cleanse it and give it +2 Hands. Ongoing: Once per round, when another Water ally leaves a district you are losing, cleanse it and give it +3 Hands. The reveal and passive can both reward a qualifying move.

unplayedCards.name: Seafood Assassin
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply 2 Burn to every enemy here, then immediately detonate all their Burn as Hands damage and consume it. Protection blocks the whole hit.

unplayedCards.name: Homeless Legend
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Survive your first lethal Hands reduction at 1 Hand. At round end, recover up to 2 Hands lost to damage.

unplayedCards.name: God of Hookah
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply 1 Burn to the weakest unburned enemy character in another district. Ongoing: At round end, the first enemy damaged by Burn in each district passes 1 Burn to the weakest unburned enemy in the next district. New Burn waits until next round. If that district has enemies but all were already burning, gain +1 Hand, at most once per round.

unplayedCards.name: The Mailman
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Your second Electric character played each round sends a Package to your weakest other open district. The next Electric character played there costs 1 less Motion and gains +2 Hands. Only one Package can be pending.

unplayedCards.name: Lola
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Invite your weakest movable ally from each other district here. Cleanse each arrival and give it +1 Hand. At round end, send guests home with another +1 if they return. Needs space.

unplayedCards.name: Repo Man
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Tow the enemy with the most bonus Hands from another district here. If it arrives, give up to 3 of its bonus Hands to your weakest ally here. Protection, immunity and movement rules apply.

unplayedCards.name: Mad Hatter
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other ally here to hand with +1 Hand and −1 Motion on its next play (minimum 1). If there is room, pull your strongest movable ally from another district here. The cheaper guest also gains +3 Hands; the other gains Protection if still on the board. Equal costs: +1 Hand each. If alone here, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Track Suit Auntie
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district.

unplayedCards.name: Gym Bag YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Fitness ally to your weakest legal other district. One successful Bag Check per side per round.

unplayedCards.name: Stairwell Sprinter
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to an unvisited legal district. Gain +1 Hand after arrival once per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Last Set OG
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If a friendly Fitness character has visited all three districts, give your weakest Fitness ally in each occupied district +2 Hands. Otherwise Protect your weakest other local Fitness ally. One circuit finish per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: Tour Van Driver
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable Music ally from another district here. Both gain +2 Hands after arrival. Once per side per round.

unplayedCards.name: Mixtape Cousin
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Music ally to your weakest legal other district; it gains +2 Hands and this gains +1 Hand only after arrival. Once per side per round.

unplayedCards.name: Merch Table Hustler
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first different Music character successfully resolving an entrance here each round earns one local Music discount of 1 Motion through the following round, minimum 1. Two discounts per side per match. Echoes do not count.

unplayedCards.name: The Favorite Grandchild
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district.

unplayedCards.name: Cousin Back From College
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move your weakest other local Fire or Family ally to your weakest legal other district. Only after arrival, give it +2 Hands once per side per round.

unplayedCards.name: Plate Auntie
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Recover up to 3 lost Hands and remove Burn from your weakest injured other local Fire or Family ally; Protect it if healing or Burn removal succeeds. If nobody is injured, remove one eligible ally’s Burn; if nobody needs either, give your weakest eligible ally +3 Hands instead. With no eligible ally, save +3 Hands for the next other Fire or Family ally arriving here through next round while Auntie is here and active; once, no echoes.

unplayedCards.name: Church Auntie’s Rival
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Fire or Family ally +1 Hand and Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Big Sister
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first different Fire or Family ally moving here each round gains +3 Hands. Three payouts per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: Second Plate Cousin
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: When another local Fire or Family ally genuinely gains Hands, gain +3 Hands. Once per round, two payouts per side per match. Copied gains cannot trigger sharing.

unplayedCards.name: Grill Uncle
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Apply 2 Burn to the strongest enemy here. Ongoing: Actual enemy Burn damage here grants +2 Hands once per round, twice per side per match. The first different Fire or Family ally successfully resolving an entrance here each round applies 1 Burn to the strongest enemy here, twice per side per match. Echoes do not count.

unplayedCards.name: Grandma Said Sit Down
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 2 Hands, or 4 if two distinct friendly characters moved this round. One successful entrance per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Gym Spotter YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Fitness ally +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move through next round grants +1 Hand once.

unplayedCards.name: Calisthenics YN
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Your first successful move each round gains +2 Hands. Two payouts per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: OG Calisthenics
unplayedCards.effect: In Hand: Your first successful Fitness move each round grants that athlete +1 Hand, twice per side per match. On Reveal: If Fitness allies occupy all three districts, give your weakest Fitness ally in each district +3 Hands. Otherwise give your weakest other local Fitness ally +3 Hands and Protection. Once per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: Night Bus Driver
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Bring your weakest movable ally from another district here if there is space. The first successful pickup by this driver gives the passenger +2 Hands per match; returns do not reset it.

unplayedCards.name: Community Cook
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Recover up to 4 lost Hands on your weakest injured other ally here; otherwise give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands. A Homeless recipient is also cleansed, gains +2 Hands and Protection. Cracked Head counts as Homeless. One meal per recipient per side per match; copies and returns cannot refeed the same recipient.

unplayedCards.name: Jump Rope Menace
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Your first distinct Fitness mover each round grants +2 Hands; the second grants +1 Hand. Each leg pays at most twice per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: Delivery App Cyclist
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest legal other district. Give your weakest other ally there +1 Hand after arrival, once per instance per match.

unplayedCards.name: Studio Couch YN
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local Music ally +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Barbershop Heckler
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 2 bonus Hands from the strongest enemy with bonus Hands here. If any bonus was removed, your weakest other ally here gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Group Chat Instigator
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 1 Hand. If damage lands and two different friendly characters moved this round, hit the strongest enemy in another district for 1.

unplayedCards.name: Bluetooth Unc
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Remove Silence from your weakest silenced other ally here. If none is silenced, Protect your weakest other ally here instead.

unplayedCards.name: Booster

unplayedCards.name: Indian Scammer

unplayedCards.name: Naija Scammer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Summon a 0-Motion / 1-Hand Fake Marriage token here if there is space, then Protect your weakest other character here. One summon per side per match. The token earns +1 Hand when a different ally moves here, once per round, twice per match.

unplayedCards.name: Black Air Fade 1’s
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other character here +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move this round grants +1 Hand once. One fitting per target per match.

unplayedCards.name: Hair Stylist
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it +1 Hand. If cleansed, its next successful move grants another +1 Hand, once.

unplayedCards.name: Stylist
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand and Protection. Its next successful move refreshes its Protection once. One fitting per target.

unplayedCards.name: Demario
unplayedCards.effect: While in hand: At the start of each round, summon one 2-Hand Mushroom in a random open district. On Reveal: Summon one more Mushroom in a random open district. Full districts are skipped. The next friendly character played in a Mushroom’s district consumes one for +2 Hands; normal or Powered Luigion gets +2 on reveal. Echoes never consume Mushrooms.

unplayedCards.name: Luigion
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand, then give your weakest other friendly character here +1 Hand; if none, gain a second +1. Consume at most one local friendly Mushroom for +2 Hands per deployment, never on echoes. Squabble transforms into Powered Luigion: the Mushroom replaces the solo +1, then jump to your weakest other open district for +1 Hand if the move succeeds.

unplayedCards.name: Black Cowboy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Lasso the weakest enemy from another district here if there is room. If it arrives, mark it Wanted through next round. If your side destroys it, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Crafty
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly inmate or a friendly support card is here, gain +3 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Boyfriend
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +3 Hands. Also give your weakest friendly Cellblock character in another district +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Informant
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy here -3 Hands. Protection and immunity can block this.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Contraband
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If another friendly character is here, restore 1 Motion, up to the Motion cap.

unplayedCards.name: Regular guy named LeBron James
unplayedCards.effect: A fictional regular guy. On Reveal: Cleanse and Protect your weakest other ally here. Once per match, when that Protection blocks an enemy ability, hit its source for 3.

unplayedCards.name: Dorothy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other friendly character in any district with a printed cost of 2 or less to your hand. Its next deployment costs 1 less Motion (minimum 1) and gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Scarecrow
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Swap districts with your weakest ally in another open district. If both can move, both gain +1 Hand. If there is no legal ally to swap with, move to the first completely empty legal district and gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Tin Man
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first other ally entering your district each round gains +1 Hand. If it moved here or is another Oz traveler (Dorothy, Scarecrow, Tin Man, or Lion), it gains +2 Hands and Protection instead. Playing or moving an ally here qualifies.

unplayedCards.name: Lion
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain Protection if you are alone here. Ongoing: Once per round, when another ally leaves your district, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Oz
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Once per match, repeat the most recent eligible entrance by another friendly Oz traveler (Dorothy, Scarecrow, Tin Man, or Lion) still on the board, including earlier rounds. If none is eligible, repeat the most recent eligible entrance by another friendly character. That ally gains +3 Hands if it moved this round, otherwise +2 if it is an Oz traveler. Cannot repeat ability-copying effects or persistent creative contracts.

unplayedCards.name: Alice
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: At round end, return to your hand once per match, except during the final round. Your next deployment gains +3 Hands and costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1.

unplayedCards.name: Cheshire
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand or on the board, the first ally returned to your hand each round leaves a 4-Hand Grin in its district. Maximum one friendly Grin per district.

unplayedCards.name: Queen of Hearts
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Execute the weakest enemy here if it has 6 or fewer Hands. A successful execution summons a 2-Hand Card Guard. Protection can block execution.

unplayedCards.name: Mr Rabbit
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, other friendly characters returned to hand cost 1 less Motion on their next deployment (minimum 1). While on the board, gain +1 Hand each time another friendly character returns to hand.

unplayedCards.name: Sherlock
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Watch both other unlocked districts through next round. Cancel the first enemy entrance ability in either, then close both stakeouts. If Sherlock is active when it cancels, he and your weakest other friendly character anywhere gain +2 Hands each.

unplayedCards.name: Watson
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Restore up to 3 Hands actually lost to damage to your weakest injured ally here and Protect it; otherwise Protect your weakest other ally here. Also Protect a friendly Sherlock anywhere and give him +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Undercova Brotha
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy deployed here resolves its entrance, steal 2 Hands plus up to 2 removable bonus Hands, gaining only the actual amount taken, up to 4. Escape to your weakest other open district only if Hands were taken. At most two payouts per side per match; copies share the limit.

unplayedCards.name: The Feds
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 8 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus and Lock it. If no enemy has bonus Hands, Lock and Weaken the strongest enemy here instead. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity block the whole package.

unplayedCards.name: DMV Worker
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Post one queue ticket here through next round and gain +1 Hand. The next enemy character entrance here waits until round end, then resolves if that character is still active. One ticket per district per side; no repeat delay.

unplayedCards.name: P. Tang
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Deal 3 damage to the strongest enemy here, then knock the survivor into the next open district. If that damage lands and the target survives but cannot be moved, gain +2 Hands once for this deployment. Protection and immunity block the whole package.

unplayedCards.name: Bonnet Girl
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first time an enemy damages another ally here, gain +2 Hands. Once per match.

unplayedCards.name: Corrupt Pastor
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Take 1 Hand from each other ally here, leaving each with at least 1. Gain 2 Hands per actual donation.

unplayedCards.name: Powerhouse
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, bank up to 3 Motion refunded by other cards. On Reveal: Deal that much damage to every enemy here.

unplayedCards.name: Revolutionary Ronald
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first time each round an enemy damages another ally here, Protect your weakest movable character in another district, then bring it here if there is room.

unplayedCards.name: Trap Vamp
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, when your ability damages an enemy here, gain that much Hands, up to 2.

unplayedCards.name: SquabbleHouse Cook
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, when an enemy ability damages another ally here, deal 2 damage back to its source.

unplayedCards.name: SquabbleHouse Server
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse Burn and Freeze from your weakest affected ally here.

unplayedCards.name: Sugarfoot
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. If it was already Weakened, gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: YN Gokarter
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Ongoing: After visiting all three districts, gain +3 Hands once per match.

unplayedCards.name: YN ATV Lord
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move with your weakest other ally here to your weakest other district with two spaces. Both must be movable. Protect your passenger after arrival and give it +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Homeless Wiseman
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Predict the enemy's weakest open district from the public board through next round. Their next character played there is Weakened; played elsewhere, your next character in the predicted district costs 2 less Motion (minimum 1) through next round. One prediction per side. Protection and immunity can block Weaken.

unplayedCards.name: Juneteenth Chair Guy
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per match, after an enemy damages another ally here or its Protection blocks an enemy ability, hit the attacker for 3 and give your weakest surviving other ally here Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Gator Boy
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give the highest-Hands enemy here -1 Hands. If its Hands fall, gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Hot Tub Hottie

unplayedCards.name: Gas Station Sushi Chef
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: While in your hand, your weakest other Water character in each district gains +1 Hand at round end. On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here.

unplayedCards.name: Energy Drink Freak
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Restore 2 Motion, up to 9, once per card per match. Echoes cannot refund. In Hand: From round 2, at round start gain 1 Motion, up to 9, and lose 1 base Hand, minimum 1. One successful hand payout per side per round, at most three per side per match; copies share both limits. Returning never resets its lost base Hands or entrance refund.

unplayedCards.name: Game Developer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Repair your lowest-Hands ally in another district with a negative Hands modifier: give it +1 Hand and restore 1 Motion, up to 9.

unplayedCards.name: Electrician Foreman
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Post two jobs through next round. Your next two different Electric allies played or moved each gain +1 Hand. When both take a job, restore 1 Motion once. One job pair per side.

unplayedCards.name: E.V. Enthusiast
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Your next card in another district costs 1 less Motion.

unplayedCards.name: Dominican Phone Salesman
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If you move, gain +1 Hand and your next card in a different district from your new location costs 1 less Motion. If the discounted card is a character, it gains +1 Hand when played.

unplayedCards.name: OG Vegan
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your lowest-Hands other Plant ally here +2 Hands. If one is here, also gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Matcha Freak
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If you have at least 4 Motion left after playing this card, gain +2 Hands. Otherwise, cleanse your lowest-Hands frozen or silenced ally anywhere and give it +3 Hands. If nobody needs cleansing, give your weakest other Plant ally anywhere +3 Hands; if none exists, gain +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Performative Male
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand (+2 if Plant) and promise to help it. Through the next two rounds, if another card gives it Hands, cleanses it, or heals enemy damage, it gains +2 Hands (+3 if Plant) and you gain +1 Hand, once.

unplayedCards.name: A Spare Gus
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give the strongest enemy in another district -2 Hands, then give your weakest other ally here +1 Hand and your weakest Plant ally in another district +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Big City Pigeon
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If you move, give the weakest enemy there -1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Baby Crying on an Airplane
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. Move your weakest other ally here to your weakest other district. If it moves, it gains +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: The Flight Plug
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other Air ally here a Boarding Pass through next round. Its next successful move gives it +2 Hands and Protection, once. Ongoing: While The Flight Plug is in your hand, your other Air characters on the board gain +1 Hands at round end.

unplayedCards.name: Airheaded Model
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other district. If you move, gain +1 Hand and give your weakest ally left in the original district +2 Hands (+3 if Air) and Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Bushedo Brown
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally here +2 Hands and Protection. Confiscate up to 4 removable bonus Hands from the enemy here with the most bonus; if no enemy has bonus, hit the strongest enemy here for 2. Confiscation never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. Protection and immunity apply.

unplayedCards.name: Franklin Duke
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If the strongest enemy here has more Hands than Franklin Duke or has removable bonus Hands, hit it for 4 and gain +3 Hands only if damage lands. Otherwise, give your weakest ally in another district +3 Hands and Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Chonk Lee
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy in each district for 2. Gain +1 Hand for each enemy actually damaged, up to +3. Protection and immunity block both the hit and its reward.

unplayedCards.name: OG Red Night
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal and at the start of the next two rounds: Steal 1 Hand from the strongest enemy here and gain it. If no enemy is here, take 1 Hand from your strongest other ally here with at least 2 Hands, if possible. One attempt per round, maximum three turns. Protection and immunity can block enemy steals.

unplayedCards.name: Red Robber
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Deal 1 damage to the strongest enemy here. 50% chance to summon one Red Robber in a random other open district; it deals 1 damage there but cannot summon again.

unplayedCards.name: Red Hexer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. Protection can block the status.

unplayedCards.name: lil Blue
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand. The next ally you deploy gains Protection.

unplayedCards.name: Blue Scarf crashout
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal and each new round: Move your weakest other ally in each district one district over. Each turn, a 50/50 roll either gives moved allies +1 Hand or steals 1 Hand from an enemy for each moved ally.

unplayedCards.name: Blue loco
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse Freeze and Silence from your weakest affected ally here and give it +2 Hands. Otherwise, Protect your weakest unprotected ally here and gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Blue Big Trippin
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Weaken the strongest enemy here. If it lands, gain +1 Hand. When destroyed, your next deployed card gains +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Wicked Witch
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Deal 2 damage to each enemy with bonus Hands here; gain +1 Hand for each affected enemy. Summon one Flying Monkeys here if there is space.

unplayedCards.name: Flying Monkeys
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move the weakest enemy here to their weakest other open district and give it 1 Burn. Protection, movement locks, and a full district can stop the move.

unplayedCards.name: Snitch
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Silence the strongest enemy here. If it is already Silenced, Weaken it instead. Protection and immunity can block the effect.

unplayedCards.name: Cracked Head
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Deal 1 damage to each enemy here, up to 3 enemies. Gain +1 Hand for each enemy damaged, up to +2.

unplayedCards.name: Miami Surgeon
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Roommate
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If another ally is here, gain +1 Hand.

unplayedCards.name: Ahki
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Remember your weakest other ally here and give it +1 Hand. Its first departure from this district grants +1 Hand; its first later return grants another +1 Hand and Protection. Each reward once.

unplayedCards.name: Mr. Trick
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Open a Tab through next round. The next other friendly character played here becomes your guest. Its first successful enemy hit or new harmful status earns a Tip; cash it at round end for +2 Hands to the guest. One Tab per side.

unplayedCards.name: Dr. Umah
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Start a Group Project through next round. Your next two different-element allies to resolve successful entrances gain +1 Hand each. When both contribute, each gains another +2 Hands and Dr. Umah gains +1 Hand if still active. One project per side.

unplayedCards.name: ATL Scammer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: File a claim through next round. Divert up to 1 Motion from the next enemy refund. If unused, at expiry open a one-use local 1-Motion character discount here through next round, minimum 1. Theft or fallback, never both.

unplayedCards.name: Hater
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy here gains bonus Hands, remove up to 1 of that new bonus and gain +1 Hand if any was removed. Cannot remove base Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Teacher Who Never Believed in Rappers
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Silence the highest-Hands enemy here with an active Ongoing ability. If none exists, Silence the strongest enemy here. Protection and district guards apply.

unplayedCards.name: Tattoo Artist
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Tattoo your weakest uninked other ally here and give it +1 Hand. Its next successful move grants Protection and +1 Hand. Each character can receive this tattoo only once per match.

unplayedCards.name: OG Skater
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Leave a route at your origin through next round. The next friendly character played there follows you to the destination if movable and there is room. One route per origin per side.

unplayedCards.name: Inmate Kingpin
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give Contraband and +1 Hand to your weakest other Inmate anywhere; if none, Kingpin holds it for the next Inmate. Later Inmate deployments or moves pass it on; each of the first three distinct carriers gains +1 Hand. After three carriers, each survivor gains another +1. Once per Kingpin per match.

unplayedCards.name: Live Streamer — Male
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Gain +1 Hand for each other friendly character here costing 2 or less, up to +2.

unplayedCards.name: Redneck
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here.

unplayedCards.name: Lawyer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it an Appeal through next round. Its next harmful status waits until round end; moving or cleansing the client dismisses it and earns one local 1-Motion character discount at the client, minimum 1.

unplayedCards.name: Nigerian Father
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Tutor your weakest untutored other ally here for +1 Hand. If it gains another net +2 Hands by the end of next round, it gains Protection and +2 Hands. One goal per side; each character can be tutored once per match.

unplayedCards.name: Bouncer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move the strongest active Ongoing enemy here to another open enemy district. If none exists, move the strongest enemy here. Protection, capacity and movement restrictions apply.

unplayedCards.name: Rent-a-Cop
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Post a warning here through next round. The next enemy character played here or moving into or out of this district takes 1 damage. If the warning deals damage, Rent-a-Cop gains +1 Hand if still active. One warning per district per side.

unplayedCards.name: The Shootout
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit every enemy here for 3 Hands; your strongest character here takes 1 damage.

unplayedCards.name: The Block Spin
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Repeat every Hands reduction already dealt here this round three more times on surviving characters still here. Repeated damage cannot repeat itself.

unplayedCards.name: The Sideshow
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move all characters from both sides out of this district into other legal districts. Each friendly character successfully moved gains +2 Hands. Locked cards stay.

unplayedCards.name: The Concert
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Choose: give allies here +3 Hands and enemies +1; or hit enemies here for 3 and allies for 1.

unplayedCards.name: The Setup
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Sacrifice your weakest character here. Give your strongest other character here its current Hands plus 4 and Protection. Requires two allies.

unplayedCards.name: The Dice Game
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Wager 1–3 Motion (both sides must afford it). Each side rolls three D6; add the highest two. Winner takes the pot, up to 9 Motion, and gives their weakest local character +3 Hands. Ties refund both wagers.

unplayedCards.name: The After Party
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Extend this fight to 7 rounds and give every friendly character +2 Hands. Additional After Parties grant neither extension nor buffs.

unplayedCards.name: The Kickback
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move all characters on both sides into this district. Each friendly character successfully moved gains +2 Hands. Locked cards and blocked destinations stay.

unplayedCards.name: The Cookout
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Serve three Soul Food cards in occupied friendly districts; each cleanses your weakest character there and grants +2 Hands. Leave one Burnt Plate: at this round end it gives a random friendly character there 1 Burn, then clears.

unplayedCards.name: The Baby Shower
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give every friendly character here +3 Hands, then draw up to two cards from your remaining deck.

unplayedCards.name: Boo Boo the Fool
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Leave a Decoy here through next round. The next enemy character played or moved here takes 1 damage. If damage lands and Boo Boo is active, he moves to your weakest other open district and gains +1 Hand only if he arrives. One Decoy per side; each Boo Boo sets it once per match.

unplayedCards.name: Mr. Mc Hands
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit up to two different strongest enemy characters here for 2 damage each. Each strike separately respects defenses.

unplayedCards.name: Ms. Mary Mack
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: At round end, collect 3¢ per enemy card on the board, up to 15¢. At 15¢, disappear and return next round as a 4 Motion / 4 Hands elephant in your weakest district with room, ignoring location locks. Keep invested Hands. All enemies there lose 1 Hand; defenses apply. Once per instance. On the final round, stay on the board.

unplayedCards.name: Pimp Swookie
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, attempt to recruit the strongest enemy Snow Bunny anywhere into your side of her district if there is room. If she is active, she Freezes the strongest remaining enemy there. Maximum two successful recruitments per side per match; copies share these limits. Each Snow Bunny can be recruited once. Protection, immunity, interception and Janitor can block recruitment. Recruitment changes this fight only.

unplayedCards.name: OG Uncle Harley Davidson
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Only if you arrive, gain +1 Hand and give your weakest other ally there +2 Hands.

unplayedCards.name: Suga Mama
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally anywhere +2 Hands and Cleanse it. If its district is still trailing, Protect it.

unplayedCards.name: Side Chick
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy Snow Bunny, Wifey, Baby Momma or Suga Mama anywhere for 3 damage and Weaken her in one hostile package. If none is on the enemy board, hit the strongest enemy here for 1 instead. Defenses apply.

unplayedCards.name: Gas Station Window Wiper
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Only if you arrive, hit its strongest enemy for 1.

unplayedCards.name: Parole Officer
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Put a movement-only Curfew on the strongest enemy here through next round. Post a Check-In here through next round: the first enemy character that moves here each round takes 2 damage. One Check-In per district per side. Defenses apply; Curfew can be cleansed.

unplayedCards.name: The Work Hubby
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest other ally here and give it a Lunch Bond through next round. Its next genuine Hands gain gives an active Work Hubby +1 Hand. One pending Bond per side; each Work Hubby issues one per match. Shared gains do not pay.

unplayedCards.name: The Guy She Told You Not to Worry About
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: If the strongest enemy here has more Hands than this card, move it to its weakest other open district. Gain +1 Hand only if it arrives. Otherwise Protect your weakest other ally here. Defenses and capacity apply.

unplayedCards.name: Crazy Ex-Boyfriend
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy anywhere for one chase at next round start. Move into its district if legal, then hit it for 2 only after arriving or if already there. In the final round, hit the strongest enemy here for 2 instead. One pending chase per side; each Ex books one per match.

unplayedCards.name: Uncle Sam
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 6 removable bonus Hands from the local enemy with the most bonus and gain the amount actually taken. Never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. If nobody has bonus, Audit here through next round: the next enemy character played here costs +2 Motion. One pending Audit per side.

unplayedCards.name: Apartment Maintenance Sage
unplayedCards.ability: I GOT A KEY FOR THAT
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and remove its timed movement restriction, then move it to your weakest other open district. Protect it only if it arrives. Capacity, district detention and story closures still apply.

unplayedCards.name: The Bail Bonds Auntie
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local ally a Bail Bond through next round. Redirect its next targeted hostile ability to an active Auntie once. If she takes damage or a new harmful status, arm a credit through next round: your next Poison character played in another district refunds 1 Motion after a successful entrance. One Bond and credit per side.

unplayedCards.name: Lash Tech
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 1 damage. Only if damage lands, give your weakest other ally here +2 Hands. Blocked or fully absorbed hits give no ally boost. Defenses apply.

unplayedCards.name: The Opening Act
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Prepare your weakest other unlocked district through next round. Your next different Music character played there refunds 1 Motion after a successful entrance. One pending Soundcheck per side; one refund per side per match.

unplayedCards.name: The DJ
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other movable Music character here costing 3 or less to hand. It gains +2 Hands. Its next deployment costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1, through next round. One successful Spinback per side per match; returning never resets limits.

unplayedCards.name: The Hype Man
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Call your weakest other Music ally anywhere through next round. Your next different Music character played in another district gives the caller and responder +3 Hands each and Protects the caller. One Call per side; caller and Hype Man must remain active.

unplayedCards.name: The Manager — Nice
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Insure your next other Music deployment through next round. If its entrance is canceled or queued by an enemy, refund 1 Motion once; otherwise Protect it and give it +1 Hand after its entrance. That deployment spends the rider either way. One rider per side.

unplayedCards.name: The Rapper
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, a different Music ally successfully resolving an entrance here makes Rapper hit the strongest local enemy for 3. Separately once per round, a successful Music entrance elsewhere gives the weakest ally there +3 Hands. Echoes do not count; copies share both limits.

unplayedCards.name: The Janky Promoter
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Post a public bogus booking in the enemy’s weakest other unlocked district through next round. Their next character played or moved there takes 1 damage; only if damage lands, it is Weakened. The trap is spent even if blocked. One booking per side.

unplayedCards.name: The Local Celebrity

unplayedCards.name: The Manager — Evil
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Give your strongest other local Music ally +3 Hands and prevent its movement through next round. At expiry, transfer up to 2 remaining bonus Hands to an active surviving Evil Manager. Cleansing cancels the contract without clearing other Locks. One contract per side; each client signs once per match.

unplayedCards.name: The OG Rap Legend
unplayedCards.effect: On Reveal: Repeat the weakest other active Music ally’s successful entrance, printed cost 3 or less, at its current district, then Protect it. Give the weakest Music ally in each other district +4 Hands. One Torch per side per match; once-only limits stay spent and passives are never repeated.

unplayedCards.name: Fitness Bro
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: At round end, if you played another character in a different district this round, gain +3 Hands and record one Rep. At three Reps, gain Protection and stop. One Rep per round, up to three per match; copies share progress. Supports, tokens and echoes do not count.

unplayedCards.name: Demon Trainer
unplayedCards.effect: Ongoing: The first other friendly Fitness character destroyed by an enemy each round gives Demon +2 Hands and hits the strongest enemy in the fallen athlete’s district for 1. At most two payouts per side per match. Demon must already be active; sacrifices, tokens and friendly damage never count.

unplayedCards.name: STOCKZ

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Dr. Fade

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Boss Bae

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Plug

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Techbro Rich

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Bikelife YN

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Midnight Mayor

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Big Zoey

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest afflicted character here, or your weakest character if none is afflicted. Store one emergency kit: prevent up to 2 Hands of its next enemy damage before lethal resolution. One kit per target.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Boombox

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and give it an Appeal through next round. Its next harmful status waits until round end; moving or cleansing the client dismisses it and earns one local 1-Motion character discount at the client, minimum 1.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Nigerian Father
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Tutor your weakest untutored other ally here for +1 Hand. If it gains another net +2 Hands by the end of next round, it gains Protection and +2 Hands. One goal per side; each character can be tutored once per match.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Bouncer
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Move the strongest active Ongoing enemy here to another open enemy district. If none exists, move the strongest enemy here. Protection, capacity and movement restrictions apply.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Rent-a-Cop
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Post a warning here through next round. The next enemy character played here or moving into or out of this district takes 1 damage. If the warning deals damage, Rent-a-Cop gains +1 Hand if still active. One warning per district per side.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Shootout
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Hit every enemy here for 3 Hands; your strongest character here takes 1 damage.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Block Spin
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Repeat every Hands reduction already dealt here this round three more times on surviving characters still here. Repeated damage cannot repeat itself.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Sideshow
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Move all characters from both sides out of this district into other legal districts. Each friendly character successfully moved gains +2 Hands. Locked cards stay.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Concert
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Choose: give allies here +3 Hands and enemies +1; or hit enemies here for 3 and allies for 1.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Setup
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Sacrifice your weakest character here. Give your strongest other character here its current Hands plus 4 and Protection. Requires two allies.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Dice Game
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Wager 1–3 Motion (both sides must afford it). Each side rolls three D6; add the highest two. Winner takes the pot, up to 9 Motion, and gives their weakest local character +3 Hands. Ties refund both wagers.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The After Party
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Extend this fight to 7 rounds and give every friendly character +2 Hands. Additional After Parties grant neither extension nor buffs.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Kickback
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Move all characters on both sides into this district. Each friendly character successfully moved gains +2 Hands. Locked cards and blocked destinations stay.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Cookout
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Serve three Soul Food cards in occupied friendly districts; each cleanses your weakest character there and grants +2 Hands. Leave one Burnt Plate: at this round end it gives a random friendly character there 1 Burn, then clears.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Baby Shower
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Give every friendly character here +3 Hands, then draw up to two cards from your remaining deck.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Boo Boo the Fool
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Leave a Decoy here through next round. The next enemy character played or moved here takes 1 damage. If damage lands and Boo Boo is active, he moves to your weakest other open district and gains +1 Hand only if he arrives. One Decoy per side; each Boo Boo sets it once per match.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Mr. Mc Hands
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Hit up to two different strongest enemy characters here for 2 damage each. Each strike separately respects defenses.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Ms. Mary Mack
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: Ongoing: At round end, collect 3¢ per enemy card on the board, up to 15¢. At 15¢, disappear and return next round as a 4 Motion / 4 Hands elephant in your weakest district with room, ignoring location locks. Keep invested Hands. All enemies there lose 1 Hand; defenses apply. Once per instance. On the final round, stay on the board.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Pimp Swookie
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, attempt to recruit the strongest enemy Snow Bunny anywhere into your side of her district if there is room. If she is active, she Freezes the strongest remaining enemy there. Maximum two successful recruitments per side per match; copies share these limits. Each Snow Bunny can be recruited once. Protection, immunity, interception and Janitor can block recruitment. Recruitment changes this fight only.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: OG Uncle Harley Davidson
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Only if you arrive, gain +1 Hand and give your weakest other ally there +2 Hands.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Suga Mama
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other ally anywhere +2 Hands and Cleanse it. If its district is still trailing, Protect it.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Side Chick
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy Snow Bunny, Wifey, Baby Momma or Suga Mama anywhere for 3 damage and Weaken her in one hostile package. If none is on the enemy board, hit the strongest enemy here for 1 instead. Defenses apply.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Gas Station Window Wiper
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. Only if you arrive, hit its strongest enemy for 1.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Parole Officer
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Put a movement-only Curfew on the strongest enemy here through next round. Post a Check-In here through next round: the first enemy character that moves here each round takes 2 damage. One Check-In per district per side. Defenses apply; Curfew can be cleansed.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Work Hubby
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Protect your weakest other ally here and give it a Lunch Bond through next round. Its next genuine Hands gain gives an active Work Hubby +1 Hand. One pending Bond per side; each Work Hubby issues one per match. Shared gains do not pay.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Guy She Told You Not to Worry About
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: If the strongest enemy here has more Hands than this card, move it to its weakest other open district. Gain +1 Hand only if it arrives. Otherwise Protect your weakest other ally here. Defenses and capacity apply.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Crazy Ex-Boyfriend
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Mark the strongest enemy anywhere for one chase at next round start. Move into its district if legal, then hit it for 2 only after arriving or if already there. In the final round, hit the strongest enemy here for 2 instead. One pending chase per side; each Ex books one per match.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Uncle Sam
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Confiscate up to 6 removable bonus Hands from the local enemy with the most bonus and gain the amount actually taken. Never takes printed Hands or creates healing credit. If nobody has bonus, Audit here through next round: the next enemy character played here costs +2 Motion. One pending Audit per side.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Apartment Maintenance Sage
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.ability: I GOT A KEY FOR THAT
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Cleanse your weakest other ally here and remove its timed movement restriction, then move it to your weakest other open district. Protect it only if it arrives. Capacity, district detention and story closures still apply.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Bail Bonds Auntie
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Give your weakest other local ally a Bail Bond through next round. Redirect its next targeted hostile ability to an active Auntie once. If she takes damage or a new harmful status, arm a credit through next round: your next Poison character played in another district refunds 1 Motion after a successful entrance. One Bond and credit per side.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Lash Tech
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Hit the strongest enemy here for 1 damage. Only if damage lands, give your weakest other ally here +2 Hands. Blocked or fully absorbed hits give no ally boost. Defenses apply.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Opening Act
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Prepare your weakest other unlocked district through next round. Your next different Music character played there refunds 1 Motion after a successful entrance. One pending Soundcheck per side; one refund per side per match.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The DJ
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Return your weakest other movable Music character here costing 3 or less to hand. It gains +2 Hands. Its next deployment costs 1 less Motion, minimum 1, through next round. One successful Spinback per side per match; returning never resets limits.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Hype Man
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Call your weakest other Music ally anywhere through next round. Your next different Music character played in another district gives the caller and responder +3 Hands each and Protects the caller. One Call per side; caller and Hype Man must remain active.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Manager — Nice
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Insure your next other Music deployment through next round. If its entrance is canceled or queued by an enemy, refund 1 Motion once; otherwise Protect it and give it +1 Hand after its entrance. That deployment spends the rider either way. One rider per side.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Rapper
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, a different Music ally successfully resolving an entrance here makes Rapper hit the strongest local enemy for 3. Separately once per round, a successful Music entrance elsewhere gives the weakest ally there +3 Hands. Echoes do not count; copies share both limits.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Janky Promoter
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Post a public bogus booking in the enemy’s weakest other unlocked district through next round. Their next character played or moved there takes 1 damage; only if damage lands, it is Weakened. The trap is spent even if blocked. One booking per side.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Local Celebrity
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: Ongoing: Once per round, after an enemy actually damages a different friendly Music character in another district, move Celebrity there if legal. Gain +1 Hand only if the move succeeds. Copies share the trigger; blocked hits and friendly damage do not count.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Battle Rapper
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Trim up to 4 bonus Hands from the strongest enemy here; if it has no bonus, hit it for 4 instead. If this changes the target, mark it through next round: its next positive Hands gain causes one Silence attempt. That gain remains. Protection and immunity apply.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The Manager — Evil
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Give your strongest other local Music ally +3 Hands and prevent its movement through next round. At expiry, transfer up to 2 remaining bonus Hands to an active surviving Evil Manager. Cleansing cancels the contract without clearing other Locks. One contract per side; each client signs once per match.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: The OG Rap Legend
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Repeat the weakest other active Music ally’s successful entrance, printed cost 3 or less, at its current district, then Protect it. Give the weakest Music ally in each other district +4 Hands. One Torch per side per match; once-only limits stay spent and passives are never repeated.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Fitness Bro
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: Ongoing: At round end, if you played another character in a different district this round, gain +3 Hands and record one Rep. At three Reps, gain Protection and stop. One Rep per round, up to three per match; copies share progress. Supports, tokens and echoes do not count.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Fitness Girl
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Move to your weakest other open district. After a successful move, clear Burn from friendly Fitness characters at the destination, then restore up to 3 actual damage and remove Burn from your weakest injured other ally there. If nobody is injured, remove Burn from your weakest burning other ally there instead. If nobody needs either recovery, give your weakest other ally there +1 Hand instead. A failed move gives no recovery or bonus.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Personal Trainer
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: On Reveal: Train your weakest other ally here through the next two rounds. Its first successful move out gains +3 Hands. Its first later visit to the remaining third district gains +3 Hands and Protection. One circuit per side; each character can train once per match. Moving between only two districts never finishes.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: Demon Trainer
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: Ongoing: The first other friendly Fitness character destroyed by an enemy each round gives Demon +2 Hands and hits the strongest enemy in the fallen athlete’s district for 1. At most two payouts per side per match. Demon must already be active; sacrifices, tokens and friendly damage never count.

cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.name: STOCKZ
cardsWithNoEmittedAbilityEvidence.effect: Ongoing: After you play another character in any district, gain +1 Hand. This continues for the rest of the game.

telemetrySemantics.abilityEvidence: Source-attributed emitted events only. No observed effect is not a failed ability; unlogged passives and eligibility are unknown.
telemetrySemantics.abilitySuccessRate: Unavailable: emitted events do not prove base-ability attempts or eligible opportunities.
